body_html:
Happy 14th Birthday microformats!!

In honor I decided to switch gears in my writing and really think on this a semiotic system and then I discover RDF was influenced around this thinking: https://www.w3.org/wiki/RDFSemiotics (well Pierce thought everything is semiotic) but interesting in my mind a Saussure perspective of signified and signifier to shape environment provides a better lens to study metadata from semiotic perspectives.
